say:1:1410808001:0.text: Good evening. I'm glad you've come, just as you promised. I'm grateful you've chosen to trust me.
say:1:1410808001:0.source_cn: 晚上好，你们如约前来，我为你们的信任感到高兴。

say:2:1410808002:0.text: You claim Indris is locked up in the palace. I'm not doubting you, but I never knew prison cells existed in the palace.
say:2:1410808002:0.source_cn: 你说因度厄被关在宫殿里？我不想质疑你的话，我只是没想到...

say:3:1410808003:0.text: My <style="highlight">wonderful mother</style>, Her Majesty, has always had a unique aesthetic. Honestly, it wouldn't be strange for her to build anything in the palace.

choice_prompt:5:1410808003.text: My <style="highlight">wonderful mother</style>, Her Majesty, has always had a unique aesthetic. Honestly, it wouldn't be strange for her to build anything in the palace.
choice_prompt:5:1410808003.source_cn: 我<style=highlight>伟大的母亲</style>一向审美奇特，她在宫殿里建什么都不奇怪。

say:6:1410808004:0.text: I'm surprised. I thought you already knew.
say:6:1410808004:0.source_cn: 很惊讶吗？你不是早就知道了。
say:6:1410808004:0.male: I'm surprised. I thought you already knew.
say:6:1410808004:0.female: I'm surprised. I thought you already knew.

say:7:1410808007:0.text: I wouldn't have believed it either, but I was fortunate enough to see her before her body changed...
say:7:1410808007:0.source_cn: 要不是亲眼看到她变化的过程，我也很难相信。幸好我出生得...

say:9:1410808008:0.text: Anyway, Indris is locked in a secret room in the palace. Even I do not know the exact location.
say:9:1410808008:0.source_cn: 说回因度厄，他被关在宫殿中的密室里，连我也不知晓那密室...

say:10:1410808009:0.text: I've already moved most of the guards away, and I'll help you distract the rest. Be careful when you search—this is our only chance.
say:10:1410808009:0.source_cn: 我已经把大部分的卫兵都调走了，也帮你引开了一些站岗的人...

say:11:1410808010:0.text: Don't make too much noise, or it'll be hard for me to buy you time.
say:11:1410808010:0.source_cn: 注意，别闹出太大的动静，否则我也很难帮你们拖延时间。

say:12:1410808011:0.text: Follow me. I've arranged for someone to assist you.
say:12:1410808011:0.source_cn: 先跟我来，我安排了能协助你们的人。

say:14:1410808005:0.text: People don't get to choose their mothers.
say:14:1410808005:0.source_cn: 我也没办法选择亲生母亲啊。
say:14:1410808005:0.male: People don't get to choose their mothers.
say:14:1410808005:0.female: People don't get to choose their mothers.

choice:5:1:2.text: No wonder you're called Your Highness.
choice:5:1:2.male: No wonder you're called Your Highness.
choice:5:1:2.female: No wonder you're called Your Highness.

say:15:1410808006:0.text: It's because we don't look alike, right? Thank you for saying that.
say:15:1410808006:0.source_cn: 因为我们长得不像对吗？谢谢夸奖，这话我爱听。
say:15:1410808006:0.male: It's because we don't look alike, right? Thank you for saying that.
say:15:1410808006:0.female: It's because we don't look alike, right? Thank you for saying that.

choice:5:2:3.text: She can't be your biological mother.
choice:5:2:3.male: She can't be your biological mother.
choice:5:2:3.female: She can't be your biological mother.
